findings.quote: Artificial intelligence offers broad opportunities while also requiring responsible international governance to prevent its use and to detriment of peace, security, and trust.
findings.rationale: Calls for responsible international AI governance to realize opportunities while protecting peace, security and trust.

findings.quote: Turkmenistan proposes the development under the auspices of the United Nations of an international code for the peaceful use of AI in international relations and diplomacy.
findings.rationale: Proposes a UN-backed code for peaceful diplomatic AI use and an Ashgabat expert dialogue on digital trust and responsible AI.
